doc.name: adcreator-ai
doc.instructions: Ad creation for e-commerce and Shopify merchants. Call make_ad_creative with the product (name + short description) and a public https photo_url to get a finished, watermarked 1080x1080 ad image with headline, body and CTA (optional sale occasion black-friday/cyber-monday/christmas with the merchant's own offer); free, 3 per client per day. Call generate_ad_headlines with the product (name + short description), optionally an audience and platform (Facebook/Instagram/Google/TikTok), to get up to 10 ad headlines each labelled with its persuasion technique. Free, no signup.

tools.name: make_ad_creative
tools.title: Make a finished ad creative from a product photo
tools.description: Turn a product photo into a finished 1080x1080 social ad image (photo + headline + call to action) with matching ad copy, using AdCreator AI. Provide the product (name + short description) and photo_url, a public https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo (max 5 MB). Optionally a sale occasion (black-friday, cyber-monday or christmas) and the merchant's own offer (e.g. "25% off"), which is shown exactly as given; the offer is used only with an occasion. Returns a watermarked preview image URL plus headline, body and CTA. The photo is placed into a fixed ad layout; it is not generated or edited by an AI image model. Free, no signup; limited to 3 per client per day. If generation fails, the tool returns an error and no image.

product.description: The product: its name and a short description (3-240 characters).
examples: Insulated steel water bottle, 750 ml, keeps drinks cold

photo_url.description: Public https:// URL of a JPEG, PNG or WebP product photo, max 5 MB.

offer.description: Optional: the merchant's own offer, used verbatim (max 40 characters). Applied only together with an occasion.

occasion.description: Optional sale occasion; adds a sale badge. Default none.

tools.name: generate_ad_headlines
tools.title: Generate ad headlines for a product
tools.description: Generate up to 10 ad headlines for an e-commerce / Shopify product. Provide the product (name + short description); optionally an audience and the platform (Facebook, Instagram, Google, TikTok). Returns up to 10 distinct headlines (claims the description does not make are removed, so some calls return fewer), each labelled with the persuasion technique used. Read-only and free, no signup. If generation fails, the tool returns an error and no headlines.
